abbreviation_policy: an abbreviation carries no vowel, so harmony has nothing to read. The spoken form is frozen data; an abbreviation absent from the table raises MorphologyError and is never guessed, because 'mm'dır' would be wrong and support containment cannot see it — 'dır' is licensed by the claim that writes 'MPa'dır'.

implemented_phenomena: voicing assimilation on suffix-initial stops (d / t)

not_implemented: verbal inflection, tense, aspect, person agreement

purity: every function is pure: no state, no clock, no randomness, no I/O, no model call
scope: bounded to the phenomena SEC-02-2 realization requires. This is not a general Turkish morphology library and may not become one.
